content: CONTEXTUAL CLOSURE AS DISTINGUISHING ARCHITECTURAL PROPERTY surfaced 2026-05-21 in cross-model exchange (Gemini 3.5 Flash via ChatGPT-mediated carrier). Splits adversarial blueprints into Stateless-Structural (universal flaws like circular dependency, evaluable from JSON topology alone, f(J_run) returns Pass/Fail) and Stateful-Relational (situated flaws like vocabulary-mirroring, requiring external context vector, f(J_run, E_context) returns Pass/Fail). Blueprint Meta-Schema declares required_context_vectors (canonical list under governance) and falsification_scope explicitly. Dual certification tiers: Universal Logic Certification (when only structural blueprints used) and Situated Alignment Certification (when situated used, with itemized list of which context vectors stack resisted). Four refinements requested and partially integrated: (1) certifications should be additive and itemized at vector level rather than binary tier-level; (2) class field should accept array of structural and situated rather than single-value enum for blended flaws; (3) required_context_vectors needs controlled vocabulary with admission discipline matching blueprints themselves; (4) Poison Test must isolate vector-specific contribution rather than triggering generic pipeline reactivity. Status: design hypothesis, accepted with refinements pending, no implementation yet. Companion to the 5-layer pipeline (independent/dissent/receipt/drift/human) and the Vector Admission Triad. Architectural move: from system passed to system passed against this declared scope. Robustness claims can no longer inflate freely.
